cards.title: SSA-CMM Self-Assessment
cards.content: Interactive 5-question wizard on the home page evaluates AI maturity from L0 (Task Operator) to L5 (Sovereign Architect). Scored client-side; result restorable from localStorage for 30 days. Redirects to Thinkific course or whitepaper based on level.

cards.title: Content Architecture
cards.content: Two Astro content collections with Zod schema validation. Philosophers collection (50 entries) drives an index page with client-side search filtering and per-philosopher detail routes. Writing collection (1 entry so far) with tag support drives the writing index and RSS feed.

cards.title: Build & Deploy Pipeline
cards.content: Astro 7 with 'static' output mode and 'file' format produces .html extension files. @astrojs/rss generates the Atom feed. Output is deployed to Cloudflare Pages or any static host. Node 22+ required. Site domain: thefutureissolo.com.

cards.title: Design System Details
cards.content: Self-hosted Atkinson Hyperlegible (body) and JetBrains Mono (code/ui) fonts. CSS custom properties for all tokens. Dark/light mode respects system preference, persists to localStorage, and toggles via button. Accent: #c8511e. 720px max-width reading container.

cards.title: TFIS Philosophical Stack
cards.content: Five Pillars: Agency, Clarity, Competence, Accountability, Security. Three OS components: TaskVal (cognitive ROI scoring), SovMem (durable memory vault), obra/superpowers (shipping discipline). Aim: one-person enterprise by 2030 (coinciding with projected AGI).
